paper_title: Ramsey and Turán numbers of sparse hypergraphs
summary: Conjecture 6.1 asserts the height-two tower bound $r(H;q)\leq\exp^{(2)}(O_q(d))n$ for every 3-uniform $n$-vertex hypergraph with $d_1(H)=d$. The paper's general argument gives $\exp^{(2)}(O_q(d\log d))n$, so the conjecture removes the $\log d$ factor from the top of the tower. No follow-up resolving it was found in the May 2026 review.
